basic_info.description:
Welcome to 555 4th St, Unit 528 at The Palms, where modern elegance meets urban convenience in the heart of South Beach. This beautiful 1-bedroom, 1-bath condominium offers 720 sq. ft. of sun-filled living space with a tranquil courtyard outlook. The open floor plan creates a natural flow throughout the home, featuring a contemporary kitchen with quartz countertops and sleek stainless appliances, seamlessly connected to the dining and living areas. The spacious bedroom includes a walk-in closet with built-in organizers to maximize storage. A modern-style bathroom with clean finishes and convenient in-unit laundry further enhance the functionality of the home. Unit 528 also comes with an owned parking space, rare features that provide practical value in city living. The Palms is a full-service building offering a 24/7 lobby concierge, fitness center, business center, social lounge, 20-seat theater, and a courtyard lined with palm trees. Perfectly situated in South Beach, it is steps from Caltrain, Muni, the new T-line, Oracle Park, Chase Center, the Ferry Building, and the farmers market, with easy access to Silicon Valley and the East Bay. Combining location, comfort, and community, 555 4th St, Unit 528 delivers the best of modern city living.

Terms: 1Years 
No Smoking 
No pet ( may negotiate)
